title: extensions.csv_http_server
description: Configuration for the localhost HTTP listener that serves FORMAT CSV exports. Accepts boolean shorthand or an explicit mapping. Loopback-only (127.0.0.1). A listener that fails to start disables the extension with a warning; it does not fail the boot.

oneOf.description: Shorthand. true = enable with defaults (OS-assigned port, dir temp/). false = disabled (same as absent).

port.description: TCP port for the loopback listener. 0 (the default) lets the OS choose a free port, which is what lets several MCP clients boot the same manifest at once; the chosen port is reported in the boot summary and in every FORMAT CSV URL. Pin a number only when something outside the server must know it in advance.

dir.description: Directory CSV files are written to. Relative paths resolve against the manifest's parent directory.

cors_origin.description: Sent in the Access-Control-Allow-Origin response header.
